_comment: #1390: ModuleData files allowed to carry inline {=KEY}default text with no English row, with the number of such keys and why. InlineDataKeyTests fails on a file not listed here, on a count that differs, and on an entry whose keys are all registered. Fix a file by adding it to a generator category in generate_name_localization_strings.py, then drop its entry.

armour_band_clones/armour_band_clones.xm.reason: Armour band clones (2026-11-17) keep their Armory source's name key and text; the Armory's own language files translate those keys, so no TAOM row is owed.
